description: This source file implements functions for outputting text with various decorations, handling console and markdown output modes, and printing help sections. It manages console color attributes, markdown syntax, and output formatting for the 'gn' build tool.

methods.name: OutputString
methods.description: Outputs a string with specified text decoration and HTML escaping, handling console and markdown modes.

methods.name: PrintSectionHelp
methods.description: Prints help for a section, formatted as markdown link or plain text.

methods.name: PrintShortHelp
methods.description: Prints a short help line, with optional markdown link or decorated text.

methods.name: PrintLongHelp
methods.description: Prints detailed help text with markdown formatting, headings, and optional back-to-top links.
